changelog.change: Initial shape: the identity, the grouping fields and the text digest.
changelog.why: The sample needs a declared row before one is written (Guardrail #3). The text is not copied: two copies of an article in one collection are two things that can disagree, and the digest is what proves they have not.

description:
One chosen article, as one element of `urls.json`.

It holds the identity and the text digest, never the text. The sample points
at one named extraction through its metadata, so an article edited after the
sample was drawn stops matching instead of quietly becoming what was chosen.

article_sha256.description: sha256 of the chosen article's text, as the named extraction holds it.
article_sha256.title: Article Sha256

publisher.description: The frozen outlet key this row was allocated under.
publisher.title: Publisher

url_key.description: sha256 of the canonical URL, recomputed on read.
url_key.title: Url Key

title: ReferenceSelectionRow
